## Executive Summary

The .fr ccTLD is currently served by 3 authoritative
nameservers. 3 of 3
authoritative nameservers support IPv6 connectivity, resulting in an IPv6 enablement
rate of 100.0%. The authoritative DNS infrastructure is
distributed across 4 distinct Autonomous Systems, improving
resilience against network and routing failures.

According to Cloudflare Radar (1.1.1.1 public resolver traffic), 9.98% of observed DNS queries resolved to DNSSEC-signed domains and were validated (SECURE), while 84.05% queried unsigned domains (INSECURE). Across major networks, DNSSEC-secured query share ranges from 2.05% to 19.84%.
